EN: Well, we've been really naughty this year.
ZH: 好吧，我们今年恐怕不怎么乖。

EN: Now hand over everything you got!
ZH: 现在，把你们所有的东西都给我交出来！

EN: All we have is holiday cheer! Now let's sing some songs!
ZH: 我们只有欢快的节日气氛！让我们一起来唱唱歌吧！

EN: The only thing we're giving you is a fist to the face!
ZH: 我们能给你的唯一东西就是砸在脸上的拳头！

EN: Done!
ZH: 搞定！

EN: Ha! Here you go.
ZH: 哈！来，给你。

EN: Christmas is cancelled!
ZH: 圣诞节取消了！

EN: I'm Boss McScrooge. I used to hate Christmas.
ZH: 我是首领麦斯克鲁奇。我一度很讨厌圣诞节。

EN: But you Dwellers with all your cheer have changed my mind!
ZH: 但是你们这些居民改变了我！

EN: So let's hand out some presents!
ZH: 所以就让我们来分发一点礼物吧！

EN: How about some fancy new clothes?
ZH: 你们觉得一些漂亮的新衣服怎么样？

EN: How about cash? Lots of cash.
ZH: 钱怎么样？很多很多的钱。

EN: You're still on the naughty list, McScrooge. Time to die!
ZH: 你还在“坏孩子”名单上。是时候去死了！

EN: Yes, even Raiders need a little Holiday spirit!
ZH: 是的，即使是掠夺者也需要一点节日精神的！

EN: Christmas at the Raider Camp
ZH: 掠夺者窝点的圣诞节

EN: Speak to Boss McScrooge.
ZH: 和首领麦斯克鲁奇交谈。

EN: Talk to the Raiders.
ZH: 和掠夺者们交谈。

EN: Talk to the Raiders.
ZH: 和掠夺者们交谈。

EN: Spread Christmas cheer!
ZH: 传播圣诞的节日气氛！

EN: Looks like we're on the naughty list!
ZH: 我们好像上了“坏孩子”名单！

EN: Ho Ho Hole in your head!
ZH: 脑子有洞！

EN: Give my regards to Santa!
ZH: 代我向圣诞老人问声好！

EN: A group of Raiders that have been preying on the locals is using a Super Duper Mart as their headquarters. Time to take down their leader!
ZH: 一群掠夺者在掠夺当地的居民，他们占领了大无敌超市当总部，快去拿下他们的首领！

EN: Clean-Up On Aisle Five
ZH: 清空5号通道

EN: Kill the Raider Boss at the Super Duper Mart.
ZH: 消灭大无敌超市的掠夺者首领。

EN: Kill the Raider Boss at the Super Duper Mart.
ZH: 消灭大无敌超市的掠夺者首领。

EN: What kind of coffin do you want, paper or plastic?!
ZH: 你喜欢什么样的棺材，纸的还是塑料的？！

EN: Time to make a mess. Clean up on aisle five!
ZH: 是时候大干一场了。清空5号通道！

EN: The motel is almost ready! But those Khans left a mess and it attracted a bunch of vermin. Let's get them out before we open the doors.
ZH: 旅馆快准备好了！但大汗帮留下了一堆乱摊子，引来了一大堆害虫。开门之前，先把它们清掉。

EN: Room Service
ZH: 客房服务

EN: Clean up the motel
ZH: 清理那家汽车旅馆。

EN: Clear the motel of dangerous creatures before opening.
ZH: 开业之前清除旅馆里的危险生物。

EN: Ah! Don't shoot! We're just hiding out here! We're in love!
ZH: 啊！别开枪！我们只是在这里藏身的！我们是相爱的！

EN: What? They can't? I've been living a lie!
ZH: 什么？它们不会吗？我一直活在谎言中！

EN: Oh! Uh, I hope this is enough.
ZH: 哦！嗯，希望这些够。

EN: Oh… okay! I'm outta here! He's just going to grab our stuff and follow after. Promise!
ZH: 哦……好吧！我走！他就是去拿我们的东西，然后跟上来。保证！

EN: Robots can't love you.
ZH: 机器人不会爱上你的。

EN: You can stay if you pay your bill.
ZH: 交了钱就可以住。

EN: We're just here to clean up.
ZH: 我们只是来打扫的。

EN: All right, we cleared the building! Now we can open. Is there a big red ribbon somewhere, or…?
ZH: 好了，楼里清干净了！现在可以开业了。有大红绸带什么的吗，还是……

EN: Oh, you know. Managed things. Look, we're all part of the team. Let's stop sweating the details!
ZH: 哦，你懂的，管理工作。听着，我们都是团队的一员。别纠结细节了！

EN: Now that's what I like to hear. I'll go get the chems!
ZH: 这正是我想听到的。我去拿化学品！

EN: Of course! I mean, look, I'm resourceful, I'll figure it out. Don't worry. Come on, we've known each other for days!
ZH: 当然！我的意思是，看，我很有应变能力，会搞定的。别担心。来嘛，我们认识都好几天了！

EN: WE did? What did you do?
ZH: 我们？你干了什么？

EN: Woohoo! Let's party!
ZH: 耶！派对时间！

EN: Are you qualified for this?
ZH: 你有资格做这个吗？

EN: Well, this place is supposed to be ready. Where's Mr. Manager?
ZH: 嗯，这地方应该准备好了。经理大人在哪？

EN: Ugh, actually it's still pretty gross. And I think I hear bugs. Let's clean up.
ZH: 唔，其实还是挺恶心的。而且我好像听到虫子的声音。打扫干净吧。

EN: How about clearing Vault 840 of those nasty Ghouls? Good luck, soldier!
ZH: 去清理掉840号避难所那些讨厌的尸鬼怎么样？祝你们好运，战士们！

EN: Thanks for wiping those filthy things out for us.
ZH: 谢谢你们为我们清除这些丑陋的家伙。

EN: You know, you'd make quite a good soldier yourself.
ZH: 你知道吗，你会成为一名很好的士兵。

EN: Keep this up and we'll make you an honorary member of the Brotherhood!
ZH: 如果你能保持这种状态，我们想让你成为兄弟会光荣的一员！

EN: Thanks. What else can I do to help?
ZH: 谢谢。我还能做点什么帮助你们吗？

EN: There's a group of soldiers called the “Brotherhood of Steel” that insist the Vault would be an ideal outpost! To meet their standards, we're going to have to provide a little bit of fire support. We'll start at the nearby machine parts factory.
ZH: 有一群士兵叫“钢铁兄弟会”，他们坚持认为避难所将会是理想的哨所！为了满足他们的标准，我们必须提供点火力支援。先从附近的机械配件厂开始吧。

EN: Clearing A Path
ZH: 清空小路

EN: Clear a path for the Brotherhood of Steel squad at the factory.
ZH: 为工厂里的钢铁兄弟会小队清空道路。

EN: Provide fire support at the machine parts factory.
ZH: 在机械配件厂提供火力支援。

EN: Climbing the Ranks
ZH: 迈向巅峰

EN: Oh yeah. We've been watching him, waiting for the right time to strike. Try the old Super Duper-Mart about a click north of here.
ZH: 哦，是啊。我们一直在盯着他，就等着下手的机会。去试试从这里往北约一公里处的旧大无敌超市吧。

EN: I'm all that's left. I suppose that's what you get when you stand up to thugs and yellow journalists.
ZH: 我就是所剩无几的人之一。这大概就是和暴徒还有小报记者作对的下场。

EN: That ridiculous Bugle “Boy” and his Editor... Soon as I saw them I could tell they were hucksters, and I wasn't buying the act!
ZH: 那个可笑的号角“男孩”和他的编辑……我一看就知道他们是骗子，我根本不会买他们的账！

EN: “Have it your way!” the Bugle “Boy” said. Then came the biggest Raider attack I've ever experienced. It was a bloodbath.
ZH: “那走着瞧吧。”号角“男孩”说道。于是就上演了我平生最大规模的掠夺者袭击。真是一场血战。

EN: I've had uncles younger than that Boy. I don't know how so many others fell for it. Guess that's what buying false hope will get you.
ZH: 我有个叔叔比那个“男孩”还年轻。都不知道为什么有那么多人会信那一套。我想这告诉我们不要相信天上会掉馅饼。

EN: Do you know where he is?
ZH: 你知道他在哪儿吗？

EN: It seems like if you get mentioned in the New Boston Bugle, you end up with your head on a Raider pike. Now we have to figure how to NOT make the front page!
ZH: 据说只要你在新波士顿号角报里被提到，你最终的结局就是脑袋被挂在掠夺者的长矛上。现在我们得想办法怎么才能不上封面头条！

EN: Collateral Murder
ZH: 连环谋杀案

EN: Meet the Settlers at the RobCo Plant.
ZH: 去见罗伯科工厂里的定居者们。

EN: Find the first group of settlers to get attacked by Raiders.
ZH: 寻找第一波被掠夺者袭击的定居者们。

EN: We have unsophisticated palates!
ZH: 我们还是有单纯的味蕾的！

EN: Not yet, but we'll do that right after killing you!
ZH: 还没有，但我们杀死你后马上就这么做！

EN: Yeah, but how fun would *that* be?
ZH: 是的，但是那该会有多有趣？

EN: You should have stayed in your Vault, Dwellers!
ZH: 你应该待在你的避难所里！

EN: First we're going to kill you...
ZH: 首先我们要杀了你……

EN: ...and then we'll have that Mr. Handy roast you up real good!
ZH: ……然后我们会让巧手先生把你烤得好好的！

EN: You shouldn't. Mr. Handy robots are terrible at cooking.
ZH: 这样不好吧。巧手先生在烹饪方面很糟糕。

EN: Does that mean you've already taken it out of its box?
ZH: 这是否意味着你已经把它从盒子里拿出来了？

EN: ...or you could just surrender and give us the Mr. Handy.
ZH: ……或者你可以投降，把巧手先生交给我们。

EN: Let me check if I have change first.
ZH: 我先检查一下是否有零钱。

EN: Yeah, I  got that - you know, *before* you over-explained it.
ZH: 是的，我知道-你知道，在你过分解释一切之前。

EN: Tempting... but no.
ZH: 很诱人……但不要。

EN: Ah, you must be the buyer.
ZH: 啊，你一定是买家。

EN: Don't worry, it's still in mint condition.
ZH: 别担心，它仍然处于全新状态。

EN: I was very tempted to open the box, but didn't.
ZH: 我很想打开盒子，但我没有。

EN: How will you be paying?
ZH: 你要怎么支付呢？

EN: Do you take lead?
ZH: 你们收铅（子弹）吗？

EN: You're the one who'll pay! With your life! Because we'll kill you!
ZH: 你就是那个要付出代价的人！用你的生命！因为我们会杀了你！

EN: Give us the box and you'll live.
ZH: 把盒子给我们，你就会活下去。

EN: We've heard that local Raiders have found a brand-new Mr. Handy, still in his original box, in an abandoned industrial building. We should try to get our hands on this collector's item before those Raiders ruin it.
ZH: 我们听说当地的掠夺者在一个废弃的工业建筑里发现了一个崭新的巧手先生，他还在他的原来的盒子里。我们应该设法在这个宝贝被掠夺者破坏之前拿回它。

EN: Collector's Edition
ZH: 珍藏版

EN: Retrieve the Mr. Handy Box.
ZH: 找回巧手先生盒子。

EN: Retrieve a brand-new Mr. Handy from Raiders.
ZH: 从掠夺者手里找回全新的巧手先生。

EN: What good is a Mr. Handy if you keep it in its box?
ZH: 如果你只是把巧手先生放在盒子里，他能做什么呢？

EN: Maybe it's the limited edition Mr. Handy, with enhanced sarcasm module...
ZH: 也许这是限量版的巧手先生，有着增强版的讽刺模块……

EN: What would Raiders do with a Mr. Handy anyway?
ZH: 掠夺者会对巧手先生做什么呢？

EN: Major shocker - Rackie Jobinson's Jersey isn't here.
ZH: 真是震惊——罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫居然不在那里。

EN: No luck in the General Atomics factory, but there's always the abandoned Vault 616.
ZH: 在通用原子工厂里一无所获。但还好有一个被遗弃的616号避难所可以去看看。

EN: Conference on the Mound
ZH: 土堆上的会议

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Everybody wants to be famous - well I'll tell this story for a good long time!
ZH: 人人都想出名 - 这个故事我可以讲好久了！

EN: The Vault has received word of a TV pilot filming nearby. It's almost certainly a trap, but send your most physically attractive Dwellers dressed for the part just in case.
ZH: 避难所得到消息，说附近正在拍电视节目。这肯定是个陷阱，但以防万一还是派你最具魅力的居民打扮一番去试镜吧。

EN: CoveWatch!
ZH: 溪谷勘察！

EN: Explore the building.
ZH: 探索建筑。

EN: Auditions for a TV Show, or trap? Probably trap.
ZH: 是真的电视节目试镜？还是个陷阱？应该是陷阱吧。

EN: You fell for it? There's no water anywhere NEAR here!
ZH: 你居然信了？这附近根本就没有水。

EN: More suckers... Get 'em!
ZH: 一群废物……抓住他们！

EN: Again, with the coming up empty. Argh!
ZH: 再一次，一无所获。哎！

EN: Still no sign of Coach, or Rackie Jobinson's Jersey. Time to venture farther out. No risk, no reward!
ZH: 还是没有教练或是棒球衫的影子。该去更远的地方了。不入虎穴，焉得虎子！

EN: Covering All the Bases
ZH: 占领所有基地

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Search farther out for Coach and the Jersey.
ZH: 去更远的地方搜寻教练与棒球衫。

EN: I said “Let our hunger consume you”!
ZH: 我说：“让我们的饥饿吞噬你”！

EN: Scrumptious meaty Dwellers also on Death's trail. Delicious.
ZH: 鲜嫩多肉的居民们也在追踪“死亡”的行踪。美味。

EN: But are they hungry enough? As hungry as the Hungry? I think not.
ZH: 但是他们够饿吗？像“饥饿者”那样饥饿？我想是没有的。

EN: Famine alone will gorge himself on Death and enjoy those tasty Horseman calories.
ZH: 单是“饥荒”就会把“死亡”吞食殆尽，好好享用这些“骑士”的美味卡路里。

EN: Let our hunger consume you!
ZH: 让我们的饥饿吞噬你！

EN: Wait a sec! Can we just talk about th-
ZH: 等一下！我们可以谈谈—

EN: Your lies can't be heard over the sound of how unworthy we are!
ZH: 我们喊“我们不配”的动静太大，你们的谎言根本没人听得见！

EN: Like flies to a carcass, everyone comes to see what Death leaves behind.
ZH: 就像苍蝇飞到尸体上一样，每个人都来看看“死亡”留下的痕迹。

EN: The fourth Horseman is elusive, but the Pests will be the ones to find him.
ZH: 第四骑士是难以捉摸的，但“害虫”们会找到他。

EN: And when Pestilence is the final Horseman, we shall be unworthy no more.
ZH: 当“瘟疫”成为最后的骑士时，我们将不会毫无价值了。

EN: Blessed be the irradiated!
ZH: 愿辐射保佑我们！

EN: But your entire philosophy makes no sense! And “Pests” is a stupid name!
ZH: 但你们整体的理念毫无意义！还有“害虫”是一个愚蠢的名字！

EN: We know Death well. In fact, our Overseer might be able to help you. We'll be in touch...
ZH: 我们很了解“死亡”。事实上，我们的监督者也许能帮助你。我们会保持联系……

EN: Who goes there? Other Vault Dwellers! It's nice to meet you.
ZH: 谁在那儿？是其他避难所的居民！很高兴认识你们。

EN: We're from Vault 144. We were trading partners with Vault 672.
ZH: 我们来自于144号避难所。我们是672号避难所的贸易伙伴。

EN: We hadn't heard from them in weeks, so we came to investigate.
ZH: 我们几个星期没有收到他们的消息了，所以我们就来调查。

EN: As you can tell, it seems they were attacked, with no survivors! Do you know who did it?
ZH: 正如你所知道的，他们似乎被攻击，没有幸存者！你们知道是谁干的吗？

EN: Have you heard of the Horsemen? We were told it was Death cultists, so we're looking for clues.
ZH: 你们听说过“骑士”吗？我们被告知他们是“死亡”的教徒，所以我们正在寻找线索。

EN: Huzzah! We now have a truce with War until the other Horsemen are dealt with! To that end, War claims that the servants of Death attacked Vault 672. So we're off to investigate and look for any clues they may have left behind...
ZH: 好哇！我们现在正和“战争”处在休战状态，直到其他“骑士”被处理好为止！为此，“战争”声称，“死亡”的仆人们正攻击672号避难所。所以我们要调查并寻找他们可能留下的线索……

EN: Crime Scene Investigation
ZH: 犯罪现场调查

EN: Search for clues about Death.
ZH: 寻找“死亡”有关线索。

EN: Search for clues about Death in Vault 672.
ZH: 在672号避难所中寻找“死亡”的线索。

EN: That's too bad. Well, at least let me reward you for your trouble.
ZH: 太糟了。不过，至少让我对你们的遭遇有所补偿吧。

EN: Suit yourself. Well, at least let me reward you for your trouble.
ZH: 随便你吧。不过，至少让我对你们的遭遇有所补偿吧。

EN: You could have fooled me. Well, at least let me reward you for your trouble.
ZH: 你本来可以骗过我的。不过，至少让我对你们的遭遇有所补偿吧。

EN: Sorry you feel that way. Well, at least let me reward you for your trouble.
ZH: 抱歉你会那么觉得。不过，至少让我对你们的遭遇做点补偿。

EN: That was a fine piece of work, civilian.
ZH: 那活儿干得不错，平民。

EN: You ever think about joining the Brotherhood of Steel?
ZH: 你有想过加入钢铁兄弟会吗？

EN: Maybe one day, but I don't think I'm ready yet.
ZH: 也许有一天吧，但我觉得自己还没准备好。

EN: Heck no! I'd rather stay in my Vault.
ZH: 才不要呢，我宁愿待在自己的避难所里。

EN: I was never cut out to be a soldier.
ZH: 我从来就不是当士兵的料。

EN: No way! Soldiers caused this mess in the first place.
ZH: 没门！最初的混乱就是那些士兵造成的。

EN: Star-Paladin Cross was collecting technology from a Super-Duper Mart when he was accosted by a Deathclaw. Lend him a hand.
ZH: 星骑士克罗丝正在大无敌超市收集相关技术，但不幸被死爪盯上了，快帮帮他。

EN: Crossing Paths
ZH: 十字路口

EN: Provide fire support for Star-Paladin Cross.
ZH: 为星骑士克罗丝提供火力支援。

EN: Provide fire support for Star-Paladin Cross.
ZH: 为星骑士克罗丝提供火力支援。

EN: And throw away all those Caps? I don't think so!
ZH: 扔掉那些瓶盖么？我不要！

EN: Okay, now that's just offensive.
ZH: 好吧，真是冒犯。

EN: It won't? We thought that was the whole point. Well, the heck with this then!
ZH: 不会吗？我们还以为那个就是关键呢。好吧，这就见鬼了！

EN: You shouldn't be here, smoothskin!
ZH: 你们不应该在这里的，“光滑皮肤”！

EN: The security honcho is ours. We were paid a handsome sum for his head!
ZH: 那个安保老板是我们的。有人付了一笔漂亮的钱给我们来取他的脑袋！

EN: Harkness is a friend of our Vault. I suggest you leave now.
ZH: 哈克尼斯是我们避难所的朋友。我建议你现在就走。

EN: Prepare to die, zombie scum!
ZH: 准备受死吧，僵尸败类！

EN: You know a “handsome sum” won't actually make you handsome, right?
ZH: 你知道一个“漂亮的钱”实际上不会使你漂亮，对吧？

EN: You can have this weapon. I call it “Dart,” because it always hits the  bullseye.
ZH: 你们可以拥有这个武器。我叫它“飞镖”，因为它总是击中靶心。

EN: Use this weapon! I call it the “Dart.” Don't ask.
ZH: 拿着这个武器！我叫它“飞镖”，别问为什么。

EN: I'm not a big shot, just a guy doing his job. Here, this is for you.
ZH: 我不是一个大人物，只是一个家伙在做他的工作。拿着，这是给你的。

EN: Finally, you're here. I was beginning to worry.
ZH: 终于，你在这里。我开始担心。

EN: The Ghouls were hot on my trail. I believe they were sent to kill me.
ZH: 尸鬼在我身后穷追不舍。我相信他们是派来杀我的。

EN: They were probably hired by those who want to destroy your Vault.
ZH: 他们可能是被那些想摧毁你们避难所的人雇来的。

EN: Here, take these documents to your Overseer. They'll know what to do.
ZH: 这里，把这些文件带给你们的监督者。他（她）会知道该怎么做。

EN: Great. Anything else?
ZH: 太棒了。还有别的吗？

EN: What if the Ghouls follow me back to the Vault?
ZH: 如果尸鬼跟着我回避难所怎么办？

EN: So, how come a big shot like you got owned by a bunch of Ghouls?
ZH: 那么，像你这样的大人物怎么会被一群尸鬼打得满地找牙？

EN: We've received a transmission from Harkness, Rivet City's chief of security, about important information he wants to give us in person. Put on your best clothes and meet him at the abandoned Super-Duper Mart north of the Vault.
ZH: 我们从铆钉城安保长官哈克尼斯那里收到一条讯息，他要亲自给我们传达一些重要信息。穿上你最好的衣服，在避难所北边被遗弃的大无敌超市见见他。

EN: Dart of Harkness
ZH: 哈克尼斯的飞镖

EN: Talk to Harkness.
ZH: 和哈克尼斯交谈。

EN: Meet with security chief Harkness.
ZH: 会见安保长官哈克尼斯。

EN: Cleanup in aisle one.
ZH: 清理一号通道。

EN: Can I talk to the manager?
ZH: 我能和经理谈一下吗？

EN: Hmm, maybe you could scare them away with Ghost Costumes from the old costume factory nearby!
ZH: 嗯，也许你们可以穿上鬼服把他们从附近的旧服装厂吓跑！

EN: Wow, I'm glad you're here. Those Raiders almost got me!
ZH: 哇，我真高兴你们在这。那些掠夺者差点就抓到我了！

EN: They're after anyone who gets near Vault 31.
ZH: 任何靠近31号避难所的人，都会被他们追杀。

EN: It's not really haunted. I think they started that story to keep people away.
ZH: 我没有真的觉得闹鬼，我想他们编出那个故事只是为了把人们吓跑。

EN: Then it's time to turn the tables on those Raiders.
ZH: 所以现在该和那些掠夺者对峙一下了。

EN: Herb Vest told me that people who go to Vault 31 end up missing. I'm going to head to Vault-Tec's offices to learn more about the Vault's past.
ZH: 赫伯韦斯特告诉我所有那些去了31号避难所的人最后都失踪了。我正要去避难所科技的总部调查一下这个避难所的过去。

EN: Days Gone Bye
ZH: 曾经的日子

EN: Track down information about Vault 31's past.
ZH: 查找关于31号避难所历史的信息。

EN: Search the Vault-Tec offices for information about Vault 31.
ZH: 搜索避难所科技的办公室来查找31号避难所的信息。
